input: RSVP to Marcus and Leila's housewarming party

gold.taskTitle: RSVP to Marcus and Leila's Housewarming Party
gold.taskDescription: Send a response to Marcus and Leila confirming or declining attendance at their housewarming party.

questions.title: What is the RSVP deadline for the party?
questions.description: Identify the date by which the RSVP must be submitted.

questions.title: How do Marcus and Leila want you to RSVP?
questions.description: Clarify the expected method of response, such as text, phone call, email, or a formal invitation link.

questions.title: Are you planning to attend or decline?
questions.description: Determine whether the RSVP will be a yes or a no.

questions.title: How many guests are you RSVPing for?
questions.description: Confirm whether the response covers just the user or additional guests as well.

questions.title: Do you have their contact details readily available?
questions.description: Check whether the user already has the phone number, email, or invitation link needed to send the RSVP.

questions.title: Is there a message you want to include with the RSVP?
questions.description: Determine if the user wants to add a personal note, such as excitement, congratulations, or a reason for declining.

questions.title: When is the housewarming party actually taking place?
questions.description: Establish the date and time of the event to factor into planning and urgency of the RSVP.
